sample:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original in-battle character sprite for a Chinese cultivation game.
Input image 1 is a MATERIAL reference only: traditional colored Chinese leather shadow puppet, translucent dyed hide and cut engraved ornament. Do not copy its huge head, giant circular holes, heavy black/red robe or cartoon anatomy.
Create ONE complete petite adult female cultivator as a colored Chinese shadow-theatre puppet, full body, standing in a relaxed battle-ready pose, facing right in a three-quarter side view. Graceful adult proportions about 6.5 heads tall, slim small shoulders, compact neck, narrow waist. Blank warm parchment-colored face with NO eyes, eyebrows, nose lines or lips; face has a gentle natural contour, no long pointed chin. Matte ink-black hair in a simple half-up bun with a muted red tie and one long rear hair mass. Cross-collar robe in muted celadon green and ivory with small cinnabar-red belt accent, dark teal piping. Clearly visible separate wide sleeves hanging at the sides, forearms slightly angled forward, hands simply drawn with correct five fingers. Long divided robe hem above two visible small shoes.
Medium and texture: an actual flat hand-cut and hand-painted leather shadow puppet, not a black silhouette. Dyed translucent leather with softly glowing warm amber edges INSIDE the sprite, restrained mottled leather grain, sparse shallow carved cloud/floral patterns and small ornamental cutouts on cuffs and robe hem. Thin dark brown cut-edge contour. Keep large clear colored areas so it remains readable at game scale. Flat articulated cutout feeling, beautiful restrained craft quality, simplified rather than ornate. Subtle discreet joint seams concealed by sleeves/waist/hair. No oversized exposed rings or screws, no rods.
Composition: one centered isolated figure filling 85% of a tall 2:3 image with comfortable margins, whole bun and both shoes included. True transparent alpha background, NO scenery, NO floor, NO cast shadow, NO glow outside contour, no text, no border, no sheet.
Avoid: all-black shadow, grayscale silhouette, primitive vector placeholder, photoreal flesh, anime face, facial features, large head/chibi, plastic shine, realistic fabric folds or volumetric 3D shading, excessive gold ornaments.
cleanup: Edit the provided female colored leather shadow puppet. Keep the EXACT character, all internal colors, hair, face, robe ornaments, sleeves, shoes, pose, scale, position and 1024x1536 canvas. Remove ALL background, brown atmospheric glow, ground reflection and any cast shadow entirely. The only nonzero-alpha pixels must be the actual puppet itself, with clean sharp cutout edges and natural antialiasing. Space between hair and arms and gaps between sleeves/body must also be fully transparent. No halo. Genuine transparent PNG background. Do NOT add scenery or generate a new illustration.

This hand must have five digits.
kneel:
Edit target: the isolated celadon/ivory/red female shadow-puppet robe body asset shown in the reference.
Generate ONE alternative BODY-ONLY attachment for a kneeling death pose, in the EXACT same colored translucent leather shadow-theatre style and same clothing identity/patterns. The upper torso cross collar, belt and waist are tilted slightly forward and lowered; the knees are visibly folded beneath the robe at the bottom, with two tiny shoes tucked behind, and robe panels spread sideways over bent knees. Preserve cloud-carved cuff/hem design, ivory lining, celadon outer panels, dark teal edges and red belt/floral knot.
NO head, NO neck, NO hair, NO arms, NO sleeves, NO hands. This is just the torso cross-collar, waist/belt and folded skirt with tucked shoes.
IMPORTANT technical placement: output a 1024x1536 transparent full canvas. Keep empty upper half. The top cross collar should start at pixel y660, x520..640; shoulders around (480,730) and (690,730); belt center at (640,865); folded knees and robe spread horizontally across x350..870 at y1200..1390; shoes tucked at y1400..1490. Full puppet ground level stays y1490. Keep torso narrower than 260 pixels. The entire body attachment occupies ONLY x300..910 and y660..1490, the other space is completely transparent. NO recentering, NO zoom, NO background or glow, NO visible rods/joint hardware, NO standing legs, no squash of a standing robe. Show a real folded-knee shape with calf shapes pointing backwards under the hems.
